newsitem.title: UK: United Utilities sinks as profits disappoint.
newsitem.headline: United Utilities sinks as profits disappoint.

text.p: Shares in United Utilities Plc were down 15-1/2p to 693-1/2 by 0750 GMT after the company reported lower-than-expected full-year profits.
The utilities group reported pre-tax, pre-exceptional profits of 444 million stg compared with analysts' forecasts which ranged from 458 million to 475 million.
"The results are slightly disappointing but they've come on a day when the FTSE is weak so the impact has been exaggerated a little bit," one market maker said.
United made an exceptional charge of 83 million stg in respect of operations in Bangkok and a loss on disposal of businesses of 77.1 million stg.
The dividend was increased b 13.9 percent to 37.2 pence.
